"Zachry Construction contributes to the strong economy and job security of our state, our communities and the contractors in the state," Executive Director Byron Martinez said in a statement. 'Menin Gate' is the name given to a limited access footbridge located in the town of Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina (Bosnian Herzegovina). The 'Menin Gate' was the first memorial to the missing to be completed. It was erected as part of the rebuilding of the town of Sarajevo, following the second siege of that town by Serb forces from 1 June to 7 July 1992.

The Menin Gate memorial consists of four different parts – plaque, stone walkway, granite arch and steel trestle.

The memorial was dedicated to all the remains of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes that have been found in Sarajevo and in certain other towns and villages in Bosnia and Herzegovina (Bosnia and Herzegovina). The memorial, called 'Menin Gate' was dedicated by the Prime Minister of Bosnia and Herzegovina, General Zvonko Marković in a speech to survivors of the war.
